# Known-benign findings suppressed by .github/scripts/scan_image.py.
#
# One rule per line:
#   raw:<regex>   — suppress findings whose matched secret text matches the regex
#   path:<glob>   — suppress findings/filenames at in-image paths matching the glob
#
# Only add a rule after confirming the finding is a false positive. If in
# doubt, treat it as real and rotate the credential: once a layer is pushed
# to the registry it is permanently pullable, even if the file was deleted
# in a later layer.

# transformers/testing_utils.py ("Not critical, only usable on the sandboxed
# CI instance"). Ships with every transformers install.

# Pydantic's URL-type docstrings use example credentialed URIs (e.g.
# "https://foo.com:123,foo%3Abar@bar.com") that don't contain the usual
# placeholder markers.
path:*/site-packages/pydantic/networks.py
